guardrail: This map assigns source-controlled owners only. It does not mutate servers, legacy Cloudflare Workers, DNS failover resources, or Grafana Cloud resources.

operation_entries.operation: Legacy Worker shard deploy and generated Wrangler configs
copyable_behavior: bounded deploy concurrency
required secret-name preflight
generated config validation before deploy
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval plus reviewed PR before apply
operation_entries.rollback: Revert the backend runtime PR and rerun protected backend check/apply. Legacy Worker shard deploy remains available only as rollback until cutover retirement.

operation_entries.operation: Legacy public smoke, post-deploy verification, and edge snapshot health

destination.workflow: Backend Synthetic Monitor and Backend Health Report

copyable_behavior: public API returns at least one article
public snapshot health reports ready data
post-deploy checks save evidence artifacts
operation_entries.approval_required: none for scheduled read-only checks; production-backend approval only when SSH-backed health evidence is required
operation_entries.rollback: Disable or revert noisy backend monitor changes through PR; no server rollback because checks are read-only.

operation_entries.operation: Backend PostgreSQL shadow smoke target

destination.workflow: Backend PostgreSQL Smoke Tests and Backend Production Cutover

copyable_behavior: shadow target must not bind Supabase secrets
shadow smoke exercises one bounded backend read
live evidence must be safe JSON without token values
operation_entries.approval_required: non-production approval only for legacy shadow deployment; backend production cutover keeps this read-only until approval
operation_entries.rollback: Keep provider mode on supabase_primary and disable backend shadow smoke dispatch; no legacy script is sourced by backend runtime.

operation_entries.operation: Feed health report and feed-fetch outcome recording

destination.workflow: Backend Health Report, future fetcher service, and read-only Ops Dashboard

copyable_behavior: record feed success/failure counts
surface repeated failed feed evidence
keep report payload sanitized
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval before deploying the fetcher service that writes feed health
operation_entries.rollback: Disable the fetcher service through protected backend apply and replay from scheduler/fetcher outbox when fixed.

operation_entries.operation: Translation coverage and quality audit

destination.workflow: future translation service quality check and Backend Health Report

copyable_behavior: language coverage thresholds
summary length and obvious-source-language checks
safe markdown/JSON quality evidence
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval before deploying translation service writes
operation_entries.rollback: Pause translation service consumers, keep publication gated on existing translations, and replay translation outbox after fix.

operation_entries.operation: Ingestion backpressure, lock safety, and queue visibility

destination.workflow: future RabbitMQ queue guardrails and Backend Health Report

copyable_behavior: backpressure runs before expensive AI/image work
locked, deferred, retried, queued, and processed counts remain visible
locks use holder-checked leases
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval before enabling RabbitMQ producers or consumers
operation_entries.rollback: Drain/pause affected stage services, leave messages durable, and replay from stage outbox after the pressure bug is fixed.

operation_entries.operation: Worker database provider modes and reversible provider switch

destination.workflow: Backend Database Provider Switch Dry Run and Backend Production Cutover

copyable_behavior: supabase_primary is rollback/default mode until cutover
backend_postgres_shadow keeps writes on Supabase
backend_postgres_primary requires explicit confirmation
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval plus cutover confirmation for backend_postgres_primary
operation_entries.rollback: Return provider mode to supabase_primary only inside the documented rollback window with writer-pause and watermark evidence.

operation_entries.operation: DNS failover controller, failover alerts, and Analytics Engine evidence
copyable_behavior: manual lock remains separate from ingestion
DNS drift and target-change evidence stay operator-visible
failover alerts exclude tokens and raw provider responses
operation_entries.approval_required: production-vps or equivalent protected infra approval before DNS mutation
operation_entries.rollback: Use the infra failover rollback/status workflow; do not classify DNS failover as worker ingestion or source it from uplift services.

operation_entries.operation: Legacy Supabase REST backup and restore validation
copyable_behavior: backup evidence excludes connection strings and row payloads
restore validation is explicit and recorded
current_api_reuse: Supabase remains rollback source until backend PostgreSQL cutover
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval before restore-proof workflow writes status
operation_entries.rollback: Before cutover, Supabase remains primary. After cutover, use backend PostgreSQL restore proof and forward-recovery policy.

operation_entries.operation: Backend host baseline, application runtime, and service bootstrap deploy
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval and confirm_apply=backend.nutsnews.com for apply mode
operation_entries.rollback: Git revert followed by protected backend check/apply; use documented rollback workflow for release-specific rollback.

operation_entries.operation: Backend host service restart and fixed recovery actions
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval plus mode=check before mutating mode=apply
operation_entries.rollback: Use the narrowest fixed recovery action, then reconcile through PR; broad changes return to protected backend apply.

operation_entries.operation: Worker-uplift service scale, pause, drain, and resume
copyable_behavior: pause writers before cutover-sensitive changes
resume only after health, smoke, and watermark evidence passes
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval before changing service replica counts, drain state, or writer state
operation_entries.rollback: Return to prior service count/pause state through reviewed backend change or fixed protected operation; keep messages durable for replay.

operation_entries.operation: Backend status, health, drift, and read-only diagnostics

destination.workflow: Backend Health Report and Backend Drift Check

operation_entries.approval_required: none for non-secret public synthetics; production-backend approval for SSH-backed read-only probes
operation_entries.rollback: Disable noisy checks through PR; drift findings are repaired through protected backend apply.

operation_entries.operation: Backend logs and telemetry collection
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval before Alloy config changes; Grafana resources remain infra-owned
operation_entries.rollback: Revert Alloy/logging config and rerun protected backend check/apply; do not restore backend Grafana management credentials.

operation_entries.operation: RabbitMQ queue and DLQ inspect, replay, purge, and repair
copyable_behavior: read-only queue depth/status inspection before mutation
explicit replay action with bounded batch size and idempotency evidence
DLQ poison messages require sanitized metadata and operator approval
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval before replay, purge, or queue topology mutation
operation_entries.rollback: Stop consumers, restore topology from backend config, and replay from durable stage outbox/watermarks rather than trusting broker memory as source of truth.

operation_entries.operation: RabbitMQ broker backup, restore, and topology rebuild
copyable_behavior: topology is rebuilt from source control
stage outbox is the recovery source for pending messages
RabbitMQ is transport, not the only authoritative state
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval before broker recovery or topology mutation
operation_entries.rollback: Recreate broker topology from backend-owned config and replay unconfirmed stage outbox rows after consumers are paused.

operation_entries.operation: Worker-uplift reconciliation, watermarks, and duplicate replay proof

destination.workflow: future backend reconciliation workflow and Backend Production Cutover

copyable_behavior: no global ordering assumption
idempotency by message_id and natural domain keys
cutover proof requires no lagging watermarks or unverified outbox rows
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval before reconciliation mutates stage or domain state
operation_entries.rollback: Pause writers, preserve watermarks, and replay only idempotent outbox rows after parity evidence is restored.

operation_entries.operation: Backend application, database, and public surface smoke tests

destination.workflow: Backend PostgreSQL Smoke Tests and Backend Synthetic Monitor

operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval when protected secrets are needed for backend API smoke
operation_entries.rollback: Do not promote cutover when smoke fails; revert the faulty backend change or restore provider mode per cutover plan.

operation_entries.operation: Backend PostgreSQL backup, restore, failover drill, and proof artifacts

destination.workflow: Backend PostgreSQL Backup Restore Proof and Backend PostgreSQL Failover Drill

operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval before restore-proof or failover-drill mutation
operation_entries.rollback: Follow DB rollback/failback only inside the verified rollback window; otherwise use forward recovery from backend PostgreSQL backups.

operation_entries.operation: backend.nutsnews.com DNS and origin routing
operation_entries.approval_required: production-backend approval and confirm_apply=backend.nutsnews.com for DNS apply/rollback
operation_entries.rollback: Run Backend Cloudflare Routing rollback and verify DNS no longer points backend.nutsnews.com at the backend host.

operation_entries.operation: Backend runtime credential inventory and readiness
current_api_reuse: GitHub Environments secret and variable metadata REST APIs
operation_entries.approval_required: none for metadata-only routine readiness; production-backend approval remains required for the separate protected value audit and every protected consumer
operation_entries.rollback: Rotate or remove over-scoped credentials in the GitHub Environment, rerun metadata readiness, and use the protected value audit after rotations; never commit secret values.

operation_entries.operation: Grafana Cloud plan and resource drift
operation_entries.approval_required: production-vps approval for protected plan/drift check with provider credentials
operation_entries.rollback: Fix drift through infra PR and protected plan/apply; backend must not mutate Grafana resources.

operation_entries.operation: Grafana Cloud apply, dashboard/alert import, and post-apply verification
operation_entries.approval_required: production-vps approval and confirm_apply=grafana-cloud
operation_entries.rollback: Keep live Grafana resources in place, revert the infra change if needed, and rerun protected infra plan/apply; do not restore backend Grafana mutation credentials.

operation_entries.operation: Backend Grafana catalog compatibility validation
operation_entries.approval_required: none; workflow has contents:read only and no production-backend environment
operation_entries.rollback: If backend catalog validation is wrong, fix the catalog fixture or validator through PR. Grafana resources remain infra-owned.
